## Security / safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, databases, Wi-Fi passwords, `.env` values, eFuse material, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Device ownership boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Browser/PAT authentication is not used as a substitute for physical-device authentication.
- [ ] Physical actions still pass through bounded validation/safety checks.
- [ ] OTA trust/rollback behavior is unchanged or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] New inputs are validated defensively.
